canonical_sanskrit.method: Transcribed from the numbered Sanskrit stanzas on the cited page; exact supplied verse text retained, not normalized.

canonical_roman.method: Transcribed from the numbered English (IAST) page; exact supplied transliteration retained, not normalized.

sources.translation_en: No vetted supplied English translation was available. Translation fields are intentionally blank; no translation has been invented.

reference_manifest_note: Includes SHA-256 and byte counts for all 24 mapped photographs, four documentary extras, post.json, and photo-captions.txt; extras are retained but excluded from sloka attribution.
mapping: Per-stanza filenames follow accepted-readiness.json; filenames were not inferred from numbers. Documentary extras 025.jpg–028.jpg are preserved but excluded from stanza attribution.
caption_handling: Caption labels #1–#10 are transcribed unchanged as commentary. Numbered anchors are represented as #N, never as filenames.
